title: PlayStation 3
description: A PSL1GHT ELF or an unencrypted SELF: the loadable segments end to end as one image written whole (console_ps3.cpp), an address an image offset; flow from the entry function and the function descriptors the data holds, the imports' descriptors named from their NIDs, an sc's lv2 system call named, the VMX instructions as .long with the disassembler's text. Rebuilt as the plain ELF the program's layout makes.

machine.container: PSL1GHT ELF (.elf), or an unencrypted SELF holding one
machine.toolchain: CodeBreaker's own assembler, or GNU as (PSL1GHT's powerpc64-ps3-elf)
